meta.title: Container
meta.lead: Use `.container` for a centered viewport or  `.container-fluid` for a full-width layout.

blocks.md: Pico includes six default breakpoints. These breakpoints can be customized with [Sass](https://picocss.com/docs/sass).

| Device | Breakpoint | Viewport |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Extra small | <576px | 100% |
| Small | ≥576px | 510px |
| Medium | ≥768px | 700px |
| Large | ≥1024px | 950px |
| Extra large | ≥1280px | 1200px |
| Extra extra large | ≥1536px | 1450px |

`.container` and `.container-fluid` are not available in the [class‑less version](https://picocss.com/docs/classless) (see [Semantic containers](https://picocss.com/docs/container#semantic-containers) for an alternative).
`.container` provides a centered container with a fixed width.
In the classless version, `<header>`, `<main>`, and `<footer>` inside `<body>` act as containers to define a centered or a fluid viewport.
